description: Evaluation questions for Customer Care: Contact Center Performance & FCR

eval_cases.input: What is the average First Contact Resolution (FCR %) across all queues for the past 30 days?
Which customer support queue has the highest Average Handle Time (AHT) and lowest CSAT score?
Compare the CSAT satisfaction ratings and handle times between Voice support and Digital Live Chat.
Identify agents with occupancy rates above 88% and analyze their respective CSAT scores.
How does our contact center FCR rate compare to current retail industry benchmarks?
